text: A dedicated workspace, a real publish, a dashboard, and an app — four steps, all familiar from Chapter Nine.
Create a workspace just for this project, publish from Desktop, then open it in the service and confirm every page — including the hidden drillthrough page — renders correctly.
A dashboard pinning one tile from each report page gives the VP a genuine at-a-glance view, each tile still linking back to its full report.
Package it as an app: name it, add the report and dashboard, create one audience, and publish.
Published doesn't mean shared, and it doesn't mean current. Lesson 92 covers both of those, deliberately.
